# Platforms

What each network the raea app publishes to shows and takes, from the app's publishing guidelines (apps/app
src/publish/specs.ts): the Publish view checks a post against them before it goes. Shapes are w:h, the first the
one the network is made for. Length is the shortest and longest it takes, and the length its feed favours. The
safe zone is how much of a vertical frame its own buttons, caption and profile row cover on a phone, from each
edge: keep text and faces out of it (`raea check --platform` measures it).

| network | shapes | length | favours | file | caption | hashtags | links in caption | safe zone (top, bottom, left, right) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| youtube | 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 |  | 3 min | 256 GB | 5000 chars | 1-3 advised, 15 max |  | 10%, 25%, 4%, 14% |
| tiktok | 9:16 | 3 s to 10 min |  | 4 GB | 2200 chars | 3-5 advised | not clickable | 7%, 25%, 5%, 13% |
| instagram | 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 | 3 s to 15 min | 90 s | 1 GB | 2200 chars | 3-5 advised, 30 max | not clickable | 14%, 35%, 6%, 6% |
| facebook | 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 | 1 s to 4 h | 90 s | 10 GB | 63206 chars | 1-3 advised |  | 14%, 35%, 6%, 6% |
| threads | 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9 | up to 5 min |  | 1 GB | 500 chars | 1 topic tag |  |  |
| linkedin | 16:9, 1:1, 4:5, 9:16 | 3 s to 10 min |  | 5 GB | 3000 chars | 3-5 advised |  |  |
| bluesky | 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 | up to 3 min |  | 100 MB | 300 graphemes |  |  |  |
| x | 16:9, 1:1, 9:16 | 0.5 s to 140 s |  | 512 MB | 280 chars | 1-2 advised |  |  |

- youtube: A vertical video of 3 minutes or less is published as a Short.
- instagram: The grid shows a 3:4 crop of the cover.
- threads: Threads takes one topic tag: the first #tag becomes the post's topic, the rest stay text.
